Isolating the sixth-degree term, we find

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-3)^{6}+54 & >-10 \\ (x-3)^{6} & >-64.\end{aligned}
$$

Note that $(x-3)^{6}\ge 0$ for all values of $x$ because the power $(6)$ is even.

Therefore, the solution to the given inequality is all real numbers.
